newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: TENNIS-HENMAN POWERS INTO CZECH OPEN SECOND ROUND.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-HENMAN POWERS INTO CZECH OPEN SECOND ROUND.

text.p: Britain's Tim Henman overpowered Sweden's Nicklas Kulti 7-6 6-4 in the first round of the $475,000 Czech Open on Monday.
Both players took advantage of the fast carpet court, blasting service winner after service winner to force the first set into a tie break. Henman won it 7-3.
Kulti had his chances early in the second set but the Briton broke his opponent in the fifth game and swept home.
"It was a tough match but I think I should have taken the first set before the tiebreak," said Henman. "He fought back well but I felt more comfortable in the second set.
"I enjoy playing a tough match right from the start, it focuses you very quickly."
